l3UsageSemantics.meaning: Declared dimensions support exact clearance checks only; they do not establish navigation or fit across a home.
Manufacturer maximum threshold is a bounded claim, not an obstacle-crossing guarantee in a particular home.
Declared dust and water capacities are equipment facts, not emptying, mopping, or coverage outcomes.
Runtime is comparable only under the same stated mode and test context; missing context stays unknown and battery capacity is not a runtime substitute.
Manufacturer Pa is a marketing specification and cannot rank suction, cleaning performance, or suitability.
Station and mop-care states answer exact equipment questions only; they do not prove autonomy or reliability.
Mapping and app-control presence do not establish navigation quality, obstacle avoidance, privacy, connectivity reliability, or app behavior.
Wet-mop presence does not establish stain removal, floor compatibility, mopping quality, or surface safety.
